observations: The saved isometric shows four complete floor mount sets and twelve independent rivets. The display-section detail exposes the bolt head, compressed lock washer, nut and protruding nominal thread; floor/channel outline is display-only.

HB104 near-cleat photograph supports a triangular foot, vertical floor bolt and three visible upright heads. It has perspective and halftone limitations; its apparent proportions do not establish cleat stock, head form or handedness.
The SNL6 plan shows paired lateral control lanes and handed diagonal linkage layouts. Approximate cleat stations remain provisional because this plan has not been calibrated independently.

The source overlay uses unchanged local side registration. It shows the U-section near the drawn channel and the estimated cleat/fastener extending below/rearward. The source does not depict enough of this hardware to verify its precise placement. No camera adjustment or per-part projection correction was made.
The existing high-speed control-bore discrepancy of21.867px remains unresolved. Correlated drum silhouette checks do not make independent camera validation.

The first mounting layout collided with four factory rivet heads. Its native and failed checks remain in channel_mount01 and channel_mount_variation01. The revised estimated foot gives full bolt seating and clears the conditional socket envelope in both stock variations.
limits: M4130 count follows SNL four; handbook two remains a documented source difference.
